race.comment: MR. MARVELLOUS (1) finished well back at this track last time when a 2.25 lengths sixth (19.23) but scored three back at this track (19.31). Form here at the trip sound including four wins. The form out of last race has been strong. Has winning claims on his best figures. FADE TO BLACK (8) has been settling off the speed lately, finishing sixth (30.92) last time in a OPEN at Q Lakeside. Comes out of a solid form race last start. Should be thereabouts. GRANDIOSE GIRL (4) was strongly fancied latest and proved too good with a 2.25 lengths win at this track in a handy 16.46. Jumping from the pinch draw but likes the trip. Capable of going well again. LAST LOVE (3) hit the frame latest (19.25) when third at this track in a Grade 3/4. Loves this draw, having won three of five starts.
